headline: Mammoth’s Dylan Guenther out 2-4 weeks with upper-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Utah's Dylan Guenther will miss two to four weeks with an upper-body injury. Center Logan Cooley is day-to-day, and defenseman Nate Schmidt has been placed on injured reserve.

Guenther's 12 points in 18 games so far this season look light next to his 40-goal year, but his 6 goals are almost exactly what his chances were worth (6.23 expected goals, which measures chance quality). The team's share of the 5-on-5 chances is 51% with him on the ice, and Utah's overall share is 6.6 percentage points worse with him on. Cooley is the bigger worry. His 11 goals come from chances worth 6.28, so he has been running hot, though his 58% share of 5-on-5 chances shows real two-way play. Schmidt's 62% share and 7.9-point team boost make him a quiet loss on defense. With Guenther and Cooley each out one game and Schmidt out two, Daniil But is up to 12:36 a night from 8:59, Kailer Yamamoto to 18:13 from 13:22, and Dmitri Simashev to 19:19 from 15:07. That is based on games already played without them.
